description: iOS app that turns Ray-Ban Meta smart glasses into a hands-free study tool. Scan documents, extract text with OCR, generate AI summaries with Apple Foundation Models (Apple's On-Device AI) or online LLM models and organize content into decks with flashcards and quizzes. Built with SwiftUI, SwiftData, Vision, PDFKit, and   Meta Wearables SDK.
